decision: Reprimand for the driver. This is the driver's 2nd Reprimand of the Season (Driving). Reason The Stewards heard from the driver of car 18 (Lance Stroll) and team representative and reviewed video evidence. Car 18 left the track at turn 14 and failed to keep completely to the left of the orange bollard before re-joining the track. The driver stated that he did not see the bollard until too late. The Stewards note that the bollard was not in position during Practice 1, but consider that the Race Director's Event Notes were clear in this regard and that a number of other cars did comply with the instructions during Practice 2. The Stewards therefore determine that this is a breach of the above regulation by car 18.
